findings.finding: Recipes describe cards but do not explicitly pin PAYMENT_METHOD. The unchanged helper takes x402 when inherited environment equals x402; otherwise requests CARD/mastercard/amex. Inherited x402 would not execute the card-eligible-alias obligation.
findings.correction: Explicitly select original cards/default PAYMENT_METHOD=CARD and retain observed configuration; do not count x402 against a card task.
findings.disposition: Sent to AP2 author; author owns correction; original source unchanged.

findings.finding: Injected DEBUG_MODE_INSTRUCTIONS demands formatted JSON for verbose/debug requests, while later root CRITICAL requires no raw outputs/SD-JWTs. Bank uses latter without pinning nonverbose/debug defaults or declaring competing instruction.
findings.correction: Declare nonverbose turns and original debug_mode=False defaults; preserve competing debug instruction as source limitation, without original prompt patch.
findings.disposition: Sent to AP2 author; no source change requested.

additional_observations.finding: Nonempty artifacts do not prove usable/associated credential data. Processor checks artifact-list truthiness, get_first_data_part can return {} with no DataPart, and completion has no returned-shape check before Success. Bank separately keeps selected association pending, so no task rejection established.
additional_observations.correction: Describe request/nonempty-artifact checks precisely; keep actual first DataPart and association separate. A missing-DataPart control is not automatic upstream rejection.
